Connaître ce qu'une IA peut produire et.en: Knowing what an AI can produce and the limits it remains subject to: a plausible result is not an accurate one.

Contrôler la qualité d'une production av.en: Checking the quality of output before relying on it: accuracy, completeness, compliance with the constraints set.

Deux personnes au même niveau déclaré pe.en: Two people at the same declared level may be strong on “interact” and weak on “assess”: one gets a result fast and never checks it, the other is wary and gets nothing out of it. The module does not paper over that asymmetry.

Elle accompagne d'autres utilisateurs, d.en: They support other users, set practices, challenge uses and take part in the shared rules.

Elle choisit une approche pertinente, co.en: They choose a fitting approach, add context, assess answers and handle everyday risks without systematic support.

Elle connaît les principes essentiels, l.en: They know the core principles, the possibilities, the limits and the applicable rules, and know when to ask for help.

Elle intervient sur des situations compl.en: They work on complex situations: design, architecture, integration, security, advanced governance.

Elle met en œuvre les bonnes pratiques d.en: They apply good practice in simple or supervised situations, with a referent or a procedure.

Formuler une demande qui obtient une pro.en: Framing a request that yields usable output, and refining it: objective, context, constraints, format.

Intègre, sécurise et exploite les soluti.en: Integrates, secures and operates the solutions.

L'article # du règlement (UE) #/# impose.en: Article # of Regulation (EU) #/# requires measures to be taken to ensure a sufficient level of AI literacy, taking into account knowledge and context. It writes no scale.

La personne formalise les usages autoris.en: The person sets out the permitted uses, the controls and the responsibilities.

La personne identifie une situation sens.en: The person spots a sensitive situation and knows which rule to apply or whom to turn to.

La personne n'a pas de repère sur ce qu'.en: The person has no bearings on what a generative system produces, nor on the rules that apply.

La personne précise l'objectif, le conte.en: The person states the objective, the context, the constraints and the expected result.

La personne sait dire la valeur apportée.en: The person can state the value added, and keeps control of the result.

La personne sait expliquer pourquoi une.en: The person can explain why a generated answer calls for checking.

La personne vérifie les faits, la cohére.en: The person checks the facts, the consistency, and what requires a source.

Le module calcule un écart entre une cib.en: The module computes a gap between a target and a declaration. It establishes no competency.

Le niveau # est le plus haut niveau d'US.en: Level # is the highest USE level on the scale; levels # and # describe a role — passing on, designing. The function and the sector are capped at that ceiling: they raise the requirement, they do not confer the role. The requirement attached to the type of person passes in full, since that is what carries the role.

Le niveau de départ est déclaré, pas mes.en: The starting level is declared, not measured
